installCommand: cd ../.. && if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; else npm ci && cd services/onboarding-billing && npm ci; fi
buildCommand: cd ../.. && if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm --filter onboarding-billing-service run build; else cd services/onboarding-billing && npm run build; fi
